A '''battle''' took place on the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] fortress [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Cyrillia/Legends|Cyrillia]] during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Operation Shadow Hand]], an attempt by reborn [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to reclaim lost Imperial territory. The battle took place following the surrender of the planet [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]] to Imperial forces and the [[Battle of Balmorra]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of Cyrillia was first shown marked on a map in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]. The battle was not mentioned in the text of the book.<ref name="TEA" />
